entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi... um, yes. I need to... I think I need to return something? I'm not really sure how it works.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, I don't know. It's the Aero Race jersey. I ordered it and I finally tried it on... and it's just the wrong size. It's way too tight. The whole sizing chart on the website was so confusing.
I see. So the fit isn't right for you. Were you hoping for a return or an exchange for a different size?
An exchange would be great, but I've had it for a little while now and I don't know if I can. I got lost trying to find the policy online. Can't you just help me?
Of course. Let me just pull up your order details. One moment... Okay, I see the order here. It looks like the jersey was delivered about 41 days ago. Is that correct?
Yes, that sounds right. I'm so sorry, is that too long?
Not at all. I've just checked our policy, and you are well within the 90-day return window for this item. We can absolutely process this for you.
Oh, thank goodness! That's such a relief. I was so worried I was stuck with it.

No problem at all. I'm happy to help. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email address on file right now. You can use that to send back the jersey that's too tight, and once we receive it, we can either issue a full refund or process an exchange for the correct size. Which would you prefer?
An exchange, please! That would be perfect. Thank you so much, Alex.
You're very welcome. The email is on its way. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that's everything. You've been a great help!
